candidate.kalshi_title: Will the Federal Reserve Hike rates by 25bps at their December 2026 meeting?

reviews.reason: Exact 25-basis-point hike versus US rounding of off-grid changes to displayed buckets.

public_contract.rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve does a Hike of 25bps on December 09, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
public_contract.rules_secondary:
The outcomes are mutually exclusive: at most one can resolve to Yes. For example, a 50-basis-point hike resolves “Hike   25 bps” to Yes and “Hike 25 bps” to No.

If the scheduled FOMC meeting is canceled and does not occur on its scheduled date, “Fed maintains rate” resolves to Yes and all other outcomes resolve to No.
public_contract.subtitle: Hike 25bps
public_contract.title: Will the Federal Reserve Hike rates by 25bps at their December 2026 meeting?

public_contract.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the Federal Reserve increases the upper bound of the target federal funds rate by 25 basis points at the December 2026 Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting, currently scheduled for December 8-9. Outcome sourced from the Federal Reserve.

If the change in the specified rate does not precisely match the displayed options, changes smaller than the smallest option of the same direction (increase/decrease) will be rounded to that smallest option, and changes greater than the smallest option of the same direction will be rounded to the nearest displayed option, with values exactly halfway between options being rounded away from zero.
public_contract.question: Fed Decision in December
public_contract.title: 25 bps Increase

candidate.kalshi_title: Will Bitcoin be above $199,999.99 by Dec 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET?
candidate.polymarket_us_title: Bitcoin price at the end of 2026?

reviews.reason: Bitcoin above $199,999.99 at any point in a window versus at or below $19,999.99 at a specified final time using a trimmed one-minute statistic.

public_contract.rules_primary: If the Bitcoin spot price according to the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index is above $199999.99 starting 10/01/2025 10:00 AM and before Dec 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
public_contract.rules_secondary: The market resolves based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation. The resolution value is calculated by taking all BRTI values for each minute from market issuance until the specified time on the target date, removing the top 20% and bottom 20% of values, then averaging the remaining 60% of values. If the BRTI crosses the threshold at any point during the measurement period (triggering early expiration), the market immediately resolves. If no data is available at the expiration time, the market resolves to No. The market can resolve early if Bitcoin definitively crosses the threshold before the target date and time.
public_contract.title: Will Bitcoin be above $199,999.99 by Dec 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET?

public_contract.description:
This market will settle to Yes if the price of Bitcoin is 19,999.99 or below at 12:00 AM ET on January 1, 2027. Only one outcome in this market will resolve to Yes.

Outcome sourced from CF Benchmarks' Bitcoin Real-Time Index.

The market settles based on the CF Bitcoin Real-Time Index (BRTI) using a trimmed mean calculation over the sixty second period ending at 12:00 AM ET on January 1, 2027, excluding the top 20% and bottom 20% of values.
public_contract.question: Bitcoin price at the end of 2026?
public_contract.title: 19,999.99 or below
